vellum_obligation: The canvas kernel must cache laid-out paragraphs across per-frame canvases under a key that holds every input the paragraph build reads (text, resolved family stack, primary typeface, size, weight, slant, letter spacing, direction, OpenType features and the font-registration generation), bounded by entries and bytes and invalidated by font registration; the paint must not be part of the key and must be applied at draw time, never by updating a cached paragraph's foreground paint, and a cached draw must be pixel-identical to an uncached one.
